Collaborate Faster. VISION - MDF4 Viewer VISION Data Analyzer (VDA) is a software application for viewing and analyzing measurement data in the industry-standard ASAM MDF4 format. It is built for engineers who need a clear and reliable way to work with large and complex datasets. Designed as a 64-bit application, VDA handles large data files with stability and performance that older tools often struggle to maintain. It provides a single environment for exploring data, comparing recordings, and working through analysis without switching between multiple tools.
